## Quality and privacy checklist

- [ ] I added or updated tests for changed behavior.
- [ ] `ruff check .` and `pytest` pass locally.
- [ ] Changed VSDX fixtures pass structural validation.
- [ ] Rendering changes were inspected visually, not only scored numerically.

- [ ] User-visible changes are documented in `CHANGELOG.md`.
